data.title_en: Three Vestas turbines collapse within six months; the farm stays largely offline
data.summary_zh: 密蘇里州最大的 400 MW 風場（175 部 Vestas V120-2.2／V112-3.45）在 4 月底（G-08）、8 月 25 日（B-11）與 10 月 31 日（C-12）各有一部風機倒塌，每次全場停機；Ameren 向公共服務委員會說明第一次涉及塔架本身、後兩次之前都有明顯的葉片故障（OPC 證人 Payne 證詞，案號 ER-2024-0319）。Ameren 稱無人受傷；2025 年 3 月仍只有約 15 部復運，Vestas 依檢查資料更換葉片（SAN 2025-03-13）。
data.summary_en: At Missouri's largest wind farm (400 MW, 175 Vestas V120-2.2 / V112-3.45) one turbine collapsed in late April (G-08), another on 25 August (B-11) and a third on 31 October (C-12), each time stopping the whole site; Ameren told the Public Service Commission the first involved the tower structure itself while the later two were preceded by an apparent blade failure (OPC witness Payne, case ER-2024-0319). Ameren reported no injuries; by March 2025 only about 15 turbines were running again while Vestas replaced blades based on inspections (SAN, 13 Mar 2025).

data.note_en: The first collapse is dated differently across documents (KTVO on 29 Apr 2024: 'Friday night' = 26 Apr; Ameren's response: 27 Apr; the WEST memo: 28 Apr; the testimony text: 29 Apr), so month precision is used. Reports from October 2026 of a fourth and fifth collapse were not verified.
